item.title: Midsummer Night Sings — Wed Jul 29, 7:00 PM — penngrove clubhouse
item.description:

Whether you’re a longtime chorister or simply love to sing, join us for music, community, and the magic of midsummer evenings shared in song. item.description:
**Saturday, August 15th | 5 – 8 pm**
The horse has carried symbolic weight across cultures for centuries - a creature that embodies freedom and strength, loyalty and wildness, grace and endurance. It felt like the perfect spirit to gather around.
Join us Saturday, August 15th, from 5 - 8pm at Pennyroyal Design in downtown Petaluma for an evening celebrating art, craftsmanship, and all things equestrian.
Artist Françoise LeClerc will debut a new collection of cyanotype prints and equestrian-inspired sculptures - work that explores strength, vulnerability, and the quiet connection between horse and human.
Sacred Order will present a special collection of horse-inspired jewelry, featuring new original designs alongside thoughtfully curated antique pieces. Wendy's newest horse-themed T-shirt will also make its debut, perfectly complementing the evening's collection.
We'll also be unveiling Pennyroyal's first small collection of men's goods - a new chapter we're excited to share.

Join us for an unforgettable afternoon at Somerston Estate as we celebrate the start of harvest season with an elevated wine and culinary experience. Surrounded by rolling vineyards and stunning mountain vistas, guests will enjoy a chef-curated multi-course lunch from Chef Cameron Bouldin, thoughtfully paired with estate-grown wines from Somerston Estate and Priest Ranch.
As the vineyards begin their annual transformation from growing season to harvest, guests will experience the anticipation and excitement that fills the estate during this special time of year. Every Wednesday evening from May through mid-September, the Garden extends its hours and fills its outdoor amphitheater with live music by Bay Area musicians. Guests can bring picnics, enjoy wine tastings with local Sonoma County vintners, and unwind among the lush grounds. Well-behaved dogs on leash are welcome. The series runs May 6 through September 16, 2026, with performances from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m. Admission is $17 for adults, $14 for seniors, and $8 for youth. Free for Garden members. New this year, monthly Noche Latina nights celebrate Latin music and culture alongside a special exhibition of sculptural works. Visit Website Event Tickets

item.title: A Taste of Italy at Centennial Mountain Tasting Room — Fri Aug 28, 11:00 AM — Centennial Mountain Tasting Room
item.description:
For wine drinkers eager to experience world-class wines made in California from Italian varieties, the Centennial Mountain Tasting Room is a must during any trip to Sonoma County. Located just off the plaza in the charming town of Healdsburg near famed restaurants, boutiques and galleries, the Centennial Mountain Tasting Room is a destination that invites discovery. Founded by the acclaimed team that guides renowned Pinot Noir and Chardonnay producer Rhys Vineyards, Centennial Mountain was established to explore Italian grape varieties grown on its acclaimed Centennial Mountain Vineyard in the rugged mountains of Northern Sonoma County.
The Centennial Mountain Vineyard Tasting features the winery’s coveted Nebbiolo, and the pioneering Carricante and Nerello Mascalese wines, among others. To showcase how beautifully the wines pair with food, the winery also offers a delicious Wine and Sushi Pairing from nearby Asahi Sushi, one of Healdsburg’s most popular dining destinations.

item.title: Bricoleur Vineyards Essentials Picnic — Fri Aug 28, 11:00 AM — Bricoleur Vineyard
item.description:
Bricoleur Vineyards’ beloved Essentials Picnic pairs a bottle of wine with charcuterie, presented in a quintessential wicker basket and a chic red wagon, offering a relaxed and beautifully curated alfresco wine country experience. Guests can enjoy their picnic in picturesque, family- and dog-friendly settings across the estate—whether on the Pavilion lawn, beneath the trellis by the pond, or at the picnic tables nestled within the culinary and rose gardens. With exceptional wines, thoughtfully crafted foods, and sweeping vistas, a visit to Bricoleur Vineyards offers a laid-back, family-friendly atmosphere featuring lawn games, board games, scavenger hunts, and catch-and-release fishing.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: The Brandlin Estate Wine & Food Tasting Experience — Fri Aug 28, 11:00 AM — Brandlin Estate
item.description:
Born on the rugged slopes of Mount Veeder, Brandlin Estate produces wines of structure, intensity, and place. The Brandlin Experience offers an in-depth exploration of this historic vineyard site through a curated tasting of five estate-grown wines—including Zinfandel from century-old vines and the estate’s signature Cabernet Sauvignon. This seated, guided experience invites guests to delve into the mountain terroir through the lens of small-lot winemaking. Each wine reflects the elevation, exposure, and rocky soils that define the Brandlin Estate. For an added dimension, guests may opt to include seasonal bites, thoughtfully paired to complement the structure and complexity of the wines. This experience is hosted at the picturesque Boathouse.
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat

item.title: Slow Looking in the Gallery — Fri Aug 28, 1:00 PM — D
item.description:
Slow Looking is an intentional practice of spending a longer period of time with a single piece of work. We will have a brief check-in conversation and then engage in at least two slow looking experiences each week. Slow looking goes beyond art appreciation. Research has identified cognitive, physiological, and emotional benefits including: Stress Reduction and Relaxation Enhanced Cognitive Engagement Emotional Depth and Empathy Improved Observational Skills Mindfulness Psychological support Increased Perceived Beauty Social Connectedness No special knowledge of art or artists required, just a sense of curiosity. Some people find it useful to bring a journal or sketchbook as part of their looking tools. Some basic art materials will be available.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
Because sometimes the best kind of community… is quiet.🌿📖
No assigned books, no deadlines, no discussions you have to participate in — just a shared space to unwind, light up, and get lost in a good read. Bring whatever you’re currently reading \(or listening to - we have coloring books and puzzles for our audiobook lovers!\), grab something to smoke, and settle in for a cozy night of uninterrupted reading alongside fellow book lovers.
Come solo or with friends and enjoy comfy vibes, good weed, and a room full of people happily minding their own business.
How it works:
5-6pm: Arrive, get settled, and kick things off with a short welcome sesh.
6-7pm: Uninterrupted reading time, lo-fi music, and chill energy.
7-8pm: wrap up chapters, meet other readers, one last sesh to end the evening!

item.title: South Pacific — Fri Aug 28, 7:30 PM — 6th Street Playhouse
item.description:
**An unforgettable romance set against the sweeping tides of World War II.**
Against the backdrop of the Pacific War of WWII, ***South Pacific*** blends high-stakes wartime romance with a poignant exploration of social prejudice. When spirited Navy nurse, Nellie Forbush, falls in love with a sophisticated French planter, and a young Marine lieutenant finds himself captivated by an ethereal island girl, their relationships are tested by the prejudices and pressures of a world at war. What unfolds is a deeply moving story about love, courage, and the transformative power of understanding. Featuring a soaring score by **Richard Rodgers** and **Oscar Hammerstein II**, including classics like “Some Enchanted Evening” and “There Is Nothin’ Like a Dame,” *South Pacific* remains one of the most beloved musicals of all time.

They were among Zambia's most popular and influential bands in the 1970s as a wave of psychedelic and hard rock gained an audience in Africa. A landlocked nation in the South of Africa, Zambia was formerly Northern Rhodesia until gaining its independence in 1964, and as Zambia established its own national identity, local musicians began embracing the progressive influences of artists such as the Beatles, the Rolling Stones, and Jimi Hendrix, as well as the forward-thinking soul and funk sounds of James Brown.
